name: FreeIndex

sources.title: Homepage — active UK business directory (450k+ reviews, live quote-request feed); 'Advertise for FREE' → /advertise.htm
Batch-provided submit URL — 404; real routes are /signup.htm and /advertise.htm

requirements: UK business required — 'Run a UK business? Get leads, build a brilliant business profile'
Free basic listing ('Advertise for FREE'); FreeIndex Premium exists as a paid upgrade (/premium.htm)
Register at /signup.htm or via /advertise.htm; review collection is core to the listing
preparation: UK business details: name, address/location, phone, website
Category pick from their taxonomy (trades, professional services, web designers, etc.)
Business description for the public profile
workflow: Create the business account and fill the profile (location, category, contact details)
Listing goes live as a /profile(<slug>)_<id>.htm page
Collect customer reviews and optionally respond to 'quote requests' leads
Optional: Premium upgrade for extra visibility
watchFor: UK-only — no value for a SaaS without a UK business presence; adding one without a UK operation would be dishonest
Premium upsell exists; review-verification rules apply (/reviews.htm policy)
Listing is lead-gen oriented (quote requests) — expect customer inquiries, not just a link
countsAsLive: The business has a public freeindex.co.uk/profile(<slug>)_<id>.htm page indexed under its category and location
unknowns: Whether the website link on profiles is dofollow
